title: Gen Z Burnout Risk Classification with Neural Networks
subtitle: Multiclass neural network classification on tabular behavioral data
description: Deep learning project focused on multiclass classification of burnout risk in Gen Z using tabular lifestyle, mental wellness and digital behavior variables.
highlights: Built a supervised multiclass classification pipeline for Burnout_Risk with Low, Medium and High classes.
Applied stratified train-validation-test splitting, z-score scaling, one-hot encoding and class weighting.
Compared a linear baseline, shallow neural network, Keras Tuner search and deeper MLP architectures.
Studied the effect of activation functions, dropout intensity and optimizers on model performance.
Selected a deep MLP with dropout, ReLU activation and RMSprop as the best-performing configuration.
Interpreted results with accuracy, class-wise precision, recall, F1-score, confusion matrix and training curves.
